snippet.title: Spellpowder: Uprising - Official Re-Announcement Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the rise of Uprising in this Strategy RPG set in a magical steampunk world. Create your character, form a party of trusted companions, and bring justice to a world with tactical turn-based battles.

Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/1775320
